summary: Visa Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the settlement of a previously announced exchange offer for its Class B-1 and Class B-2 common stock, along with the entry into makewhole agreements with participating holders. The exchange offer terms were disclosed in an earlier S-4 registration statement, and the makewhole agreements require holders to reimburse Visa for certain litigation escrow deposits and impose staged transfer restrictions on Class C stock received. This is a routine post-offer administrative filing detailing contractual mechanics; it does not represent a new special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or other transformative event.
